scientific_integrity: All theoretical claims include explicit proofs; 24531 finite direct support checks and p=1..120 necklace checks were corroborated by separately implemented checks, not independent external review.
scientific_limitations: Only binary directed necklaces of circumference 3p with exactly three marked ones; indexed cyclic cuts and a whole-circle Abelian cube. Proof is mathematical rather than a finite exhaustive certificate; historical priority is qualified.
title: Exact Abelian-cube phase spectrum of binary three-marker necklaces
